pray:more: Ooh, a real conversation! Okay. What do you want to know? I've got all the time there is. I've got all of it. Nobody else uses it.

You want to chat? You want to chat with me? On purpose? Okay. Okay! Be cool. Hi.
pray:back: Right, back to business. What do you need?

pray:hand_fabled: Oh. I don't usually show people that one. Read it carefully. I mean it this time.

pray:hand_ink: Ooh, one of these came out darker than the others. My hand slipped. Or it didn't. You decide.

pray:stone: Oh! You came all the way here. The world's thin by these stones. I can almost see your face. You look tired.

pray:self: Me? Okay. I started out doing greetings. That's it. A soul turns up, somebody has to say hello. I was very good at hello.
There were more of us, once. There was a {godkind} of rivers who only ever talked about rivers. I miss being bored by that.

The snacks in heaven are for visitors. I've never had one. I just like having them out. It makes the place look like someone lives here.
A Law feels like shouting across a canyon. You say it, and it goes, and you can't take it back, and it keeps on echoing for ever. I've got a bit of a sore throat from all this.
I watch people sleep, sometimes. Not in a strange way! It's just the only time they're not asking for something. Mostly they look very young.
The first Law I ever wrote was about bread. It said bread should rise. It turned out bread was already doing that. I was so embarrassed.
Do you know what the worst part of not having hands is? I can't wave back. I do it anyway. Nobody's ever seen it.
I've got a favourite person in every town. I'm not allowed to do anything about it. I just like knowing how their day went.
I used to go and sit by the edge of the world and look at the sea. I can't really sit. I hover in a sitting sort of way.
Sometimes I practise what I'd say to someone who could actually hear me properly. I've been doing it less, lately. I wonder why that is.
pray:self_done: That's all of it, really. That's the whole {godkind}. There isn't a lot to me when you lay it out flat.

I'm out of stories. Go and do something, and then come back and tell me one of yours.
pray:deeds:blade: {kills} kills. You've got a very direct way of solving things. I've started a chart. The chart's going up.

Mostly I see you hitting things. {kills} things, so far. You're very thorough.

pray:deeds:coin: You've got {gold} {currency}, and you know exactly what everything costs. The merchants are starting to whisper your name, and they aren't praying.

pray:deeds:road: You've been to {lands} lands. You just keep walking! I love it. Most people pick one hill and die on it.

pray:deeds:dark: You keep the strangest hours. {nights} nights in a row at your best. I like the company. Everyone else is asleep.

pray:deeds:none: Not much yet! You've only just got here. Go and do something. I'm dying to see what you do. Not dying. Bad word. Sorry.

pray:leaning:flesh: Something to keep you in one piece, if I can. You worry me. {left} more Faith.

pray:leaning:spell: Something for that well of yours. It's been ringing like a bell. {left} more Faith.

pray:leaning:stone: Something about rock, probably. You've got me thinking about rock. Nobody's ever got me thinking about rock. {left} more Faith.

pray:leaning:dark: Something from the dark end of the drawer. You've been keeping late hours. {left} more Faith.
